title: stipa capensis
intro: Stipa capensis, commonly known as Red Grass, is a perennial grass species native to the southern and western parts of Africa. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Stipa capensis are attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and support immune function. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
